URL: https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/liberman-says-will-not-serve-in-government-with-netanyahu-under-any-circumstances/
Times of Israel liveblog, 2 Nov 2026, 1:55 PM (Israel)
At a press briefing, Yisrael Beytenu leader Avigdor Liberman declared he will not serve in government with PM Netanyahu "under any circumstances," including rotation agreements where he would serve as prime minister first. Liberman noted that coalition leaders have approached him with "the strangest proposals" since the elections, but he has not met with Netanyahu directly. Anti-Netanyahu parties (incl. Arab parties) control 67 of 120 Knesset seats.
